title: Linux System Administrator
description: Master enterprise Linux operating systems, user management, file systems, systemd, process scheduling, shell automation, and security hardening.

goal.objective: Administer, automate, and harden Linux enterprise servers that form the foundational backbone of modern global computing.

learn.summary: Master Linux kernel architecture, the boot sequence, systemd service units, LVM disk storage, package managers, network troubleshooting, and shell scripting.
key_competencies: Linux Kernel, Boot Process & Systemd Management

capstone_projects.title: Automated Hardened Linux Server Deployment Suite
capstone_projects.description: Create an automated provisioning script applying CIS Benchmark security hardening, auditd logging, and custom systemd watchdogs.

interview_focus: Troubleshooting Linux High Load Average (CPU vs I/O Wait)
SELinux Contexts & Permissive vs Enforcing Modes

tree.name: Linux Fundamentals
tree.description: Master the foundational concepts of Linux, including the command-line interface, file system, user management, process control, and software package management, crucial for any system administrator.

children.name: Command Line Interface Essentials
children.description: Navigate the shell effectively, execute basic and advanced commands, understand input/output redirection, pipes, aliases, environment variables, and basic shell customization.

children.name: Filesystem Hierarchy, Permissions & Attributes
children.description: Understand the Linux Filesystem Hierarchy Standard (FHS), manage file and directory permissions (chmod, chown, sticky bit, SGID, SUID), work with hard/soft links, and grasp basic Access Control Lists (ACLs).

children.name: User, Group, and Sudo Management
children.description: Create, modify, and delete user accounts and groups. Understand UID/GID, password policies, shadow files, and configure sudo privileges with a focus on security best practices.

resources.title: Systemd and Service Management (Learn Linux TV)

children.name: Software Package Management
children.description: Utilize diverse package managers (apt, yum, dnf, pacman) to install, update, remove, and query software packages. Understand repositories, managing external sources (PPAs, EPEL), and resolving dependencies.

children.name: Process Management and Job Control
children.description: Monitor and manage processes (ps, top, htop, kill, nice, renice), understand background/foreground jobs, use `nohup`, `screen`, `tmux`, and analyze process states for troubleshooting.

children.name: Boot Process and System Initialization
children.description: Understand the Linux boot sequence (BIOS/UEFI, GRUB, Kernel, initramfs), runlevels/targets, and system initialization with systemd. Diagnose boot failures and perform recovery.

tree.name: Core System Services and Networking
tree.description: Manage essential Linux services, configure network interfaces, secure remote access, and understand fundamental networking concepts vital for server operation.

resources.title: Red Hat Enterprise Linux Documentation - Networking Guide
Systemd and Service Management (Learn Linux TV)

children.name: Systemd Service Management
children.description: Master service management with systemctl (start, stop, enable, disable, mask, status). Understand service units, targets, dependencies, and create custom systemd unit files.

children.name: System Logging and Journalctl
children.description: Understand syslog/rsyslog, logrotate configuration for log management, and master system logs using journalctl for effective troubleshooting, including persistent logging.

children.name: Network Configuration and Troubleshooting
children.description: Configure network interfaces (IP addresses, netmasks, gateways, DNS) using modern tools (ip, nmcli). Understand basic network utilities (ping, traceroute, netstat, ss, dig, host), diagnose connectivity issues, and grasp basic IPv6 concepts.

children.name: SSH and Secure Remote Access
children.description: Configure SSH for secure remote access, generate and manage SSH keys, understand SSH agents, `authorized_keys`, and implement basic SSH hardening techniques (e.g., disabling password auth).

resources.title: Systemd and Service Management (Learn Linux TV)

children.name: Firewall Management and Network Filtering
children.description: Configure and manage Linux firewalls (iptables, nftables, firewalld, ufw) to control inbound and outbound network traffic, define zones, and understand packet filtering concepts.

resources.title: How To Configure a Firewall with UFW on Ubuntu 20.04

children.name: Scheduled Tasks and Job Automation
children.description: Automate recurring tasks efficiently using cron jobs, anacron for systems that are not always on, and systemd timers for more flexible and robust scheduling.

resources.title: How to Schedule Tasks on Linux Using Cron

children.name: DNS and DHCP Fundamentals
children.description: Understand the basics of DNS resolution, common record types (A, CNAME, MX), and how to configure client-side DNS. Grasp DHCP principles and client configuration.

tree.name: Storage and Disk Management
tree.description: Gain expertise in disk partitioning, filesystem management, Logical Volume Management (LVM), and setting up various storage solutions and robust backup strategies for production.

resources.title: Systemd and Service Management (Learn Linux TV)

children.name: Disk Partitioning and Filesystems
children.description: Manage disk partitions (fdisk, parted, gdisk), create and manage filesystems (ext4, XFS, Btrfs, ZFS), understand mounting/unmounting, and configure persistent mounting with `/etc/fstab` using UUIDs and labels.

children.name: Logical Volume Management (LVM)
children.description: Implement LVM for flexible disk management, including creating physical volumes, volume groups, logical volumes, and extending/shrinking filesystems with online operations.

children.name: Advanced Storage Solutions and Concepts
children.description: Configure network file systems (NFS, Samba/CIFS), understand RAID concepts (hardware vs. software, levels), explore iSCSI for block storage, and grasp distributed file systems like GlusterFS or Ceph fundamentals.

resources.title: Understanding and Using NFS in Linux

children.name: Backup, Restore and Disaster Recovery Strategies
children.description: Develop robust backup strategies using tools like rsync, tar, dd, `restic`, `borgbackup`. Implement disaster recovery procedures, including bare-metal recovery, snapshots, and regular restore tests.

resources.title: Systemd and Service Management (Learn Linux TV)

tree.name: Linux System Security and Hardening
tree.description: Apply security best practices, harden Linux systems against various threats, manage complex access controls, understand encryption, and implement auditing for compliance in production environments.

children.name: OS Hardening Best Practices
children.description: Implement security configurations for services, restrict unnecessary daemons, secure boot processes, apply kernel tuning (sysctl hardening), and manage system time with NTP/Chrony.

children.name: Advanced Access Control and Authentication
children.description: Understand Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM) configuration, integrate with centralized authentication systems (LDAP/AD via SSSD), and master Mandatory Access Control (SELinux/AppArmor) policies and troubleshooting.

children.name: Encryption and Secrets Management
children.description: Implement disk encryption (LUKS), understand file-level encryption, manage SSL/TLS certificates for services, and learn best practices for handling sensitive data and secrets.

resources.title: Systemd and Service Management (Learn Linux TV)

children.name: System Auditing and Compliance
children.description: Configure and analyze system audit logs (auditd), understand file integrity monitoring (AIDE, Tripwire), and implement basic compliance frameworks (e.g., CIS Benchmarks, NIST).

children.name: Vulnerability Management and Patching
children.description: Implement systematic patching strategies, identify common vulnerabilities and exposures (CVEs), use vulnerability scanners, and secure against known exploits and zero-day threats.

tree.name: Automation and Configuration Management
tree.description: Automate administrative tasks, manage server configurations idempotently, and deploy applications using advanced scripting and industry-standard configuration management tools.

children.name: Advanced Bash Scripting
children.description: Write robust shell scripts with functions, error handling, input validation, loops, conditionals, arrays, and advanced text processing tools (sed, awk, grep, regex).

resources.title: Systemd and Service Management (Learn Linux TV)

children.name: Python Scripting for System Administration
children.description: Utilize Python for more complex automation tasks, interact with REST APIs, parse data (JSON/YAML), and develop custom tools using libraries like `subprocess`, `paramiko`, `requests`, `os`, `sys`.

resources.title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python

children.name: Ansible Fundamentals
children.description: Learn Ansible architecture, write declarative playbooks, manage inventory, use modules, variables, handlers, and conditionals for efficient server automation and orchestration.

children.name: Advanced Ansible: Roles, Vault, Galaxy, & Tower
children.description: Organize playbooks using roles, manage sensitive data with Ansible Vault, leverage Ansible Galaxy for content, understand dynamic inventory, and get an overview of Ansible Tower/AWX.

tree.name: Monitoring and Troubleshooting
tree.description: Implement comprehensive system monitoring, analyze performance metrics, and apply systematic methodologies to diagnose and resolve complex system issues in production.

resources.title: Systemd and Service Management (Learn Linux TV)

children.name: System Performance Monitoring
children.description: Monitor CPU, memory, disk I/O, and network usage using command-line tools (top, htop, sar, iostat, vmstat, dstat) and analyze output for performance bottlenecks.

children.name: Advanced System Debugging Tools
children.description: Utilize powerful debugging tools like `strace` for tracing system calls, `lsof` for open files/sockets, and `tcpdump` for network packet analysis to pinpoint complex issues.

resources.title: Using Strace to Troubleshoot Linux Problems

children.name: Advanced Log Analysis and Centralized Logging
children.description: Perform advanced log file analysis, identify patterns, correlate events across systems, and understand concepts of centralized logging solutions (e.g., ELK Stack, Grafana Loki, Splunk).

children.name: Metrics Collection, Alerting, and Visualization
children.description: Set up robust metrics collection with Prometheus, configure sophisticated alerts using Alertmanager, and create interactive dashboards using Grafana for comprehensive system health visualization.

resources.title: Systemd and Service Management (Learn Linux TV)

children.name: Advanced Troubleshooting Methodologies
children.description: Apply structured troubleshooting approaches (e.g., OSI model, runbook-driven, divide and conquer, 5 Whys) to diagnose and resolve complex system and network problems efficiently.

tree.name: Incident Response and Operations
tree.description: Develop skills to effectively respond to system incidents, conduct root cause analysis, and create repeatable operational runbooks for efficient production environment management.

children.name: Incident Response Process and Communication
children.description: Understand the phases of incident response (preparation, identification, containment, eradication, recovery, post-mortem), define roles, and master effective communication strategies during incidents.

resources.title: NIST Computer Security Incident Handling Guide

children.name: Runbook and Playbook Development
children.description: Create detailed, actionable runbooks and playbooks for common operational procedures and incident resolutions, ensuring consistency, efficiency, and knowledge transfer.

resources.title: Systemd and Service Management (Learn Linux TV)

children.name: Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Techniques
children.description: Learn techniques for performing effective Root Cause Analysis (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagram) to identify underlying issues, prevent recurrence of incidents, and improve system reliability.

children.name: Disaster Recovery Planning and Business Continuity
children.description: Develop comprehensive strategies and plans for disaster recovery, ensuring business continuity, minimal downtime (RTO/RPO), and resilience in critical situations.

tree.name: Linux in Virtualized and Cloud Environments
tree.description: Explore the role of Linux in virtualization platforms and cloud computing, including fundamental containerization concepts and managing Linux instances in modern infrastructure.

children.name: Virtualization Concepts and Hypervisors
children.description: Understand hypervisors (Type 1 and Type 2), virtual machines, and basic operation of virtualization technologies like KVM, libvirt, VirtualBox, or VMware, including virtual networking and storage.

resources.title: Systemd and Service Management (Learn Linux TV)

children.name: Linux in Public Cloud Environments
children.description: Manage Linux instances on major cloud platforms (AWS EC2, Azure VMs, Google Compute Engine), focusing on deployment, scaling, cloud-specific networking, instance metadata, and security groups.

children.name: Containerization Fundamentals with Docker
children.description: Introduce Docker basics: container images, running containers, Dockerfiles for image creation, container networking, volumes, and managing containers with the Docker CLI.

children.name: Docker Compose and Basic Orchestration
children.description: Learn to define and run multi-container Docker applications using Docker Compose. Understand concepts of container orchestration and get an overview of Kubernetes (k8s) as the industry standard.

tree.name: Capstone Project: Production Server Build & Operations
tree.description: Apply all learned skills to provision, secure, automate, monitor, and troubleshoot a production-ready Linux server environment with comprehensive documentation, simulating real-world scenarios.

resources.title: Systemd and Service Management (Learn Linux TV)

children.name: Production-Ready Web Server Deployment
children.description: Deploy a secure web server (e.g., Nginx/Apache) with TLS, implement SSH hardening, configure firewalls, set up robust logging, automated backups, comprehensive monitoring (Prometheus/Grafana), and create a detailed operational runbook.

children.name: Practice Lab: Broken Server Recovery & Incident Simulation
children.description: Diagnose and recover a Linux service from various simulated failures (disk, permission, network, configuration, process, security misconfiguration) and document the resolution process as part of an incident report.

children.name: Introduction to CI/CD for Infrastructure
children.description: Understand the basics of Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, how they apply to infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and tools like Jenkins or GitLab CI for automated deployments.
